proposed_comments.title: Refresh immersive color policy before reapplying app mode
proposed_comments.body:
### Refresh immersive color policy before reapplying app mode

**Severity:** `medium`

`Refresh()` re-queries `ShouldAppsUseDarkMode` without refreshing `uxtheme`'s cached immersive-color policy, so an `AppsUseLightTheme` change can leave the old value in use. Load ordinal 104 (`RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState`) and call it before reapplying `SetPreferredAppMode`.

confidence.rationale: Refresh() re-queries ShouldAppsUseDarkMode without calling RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState (ordinal 104), leaving cached uxtheme immersive color state stale after an AppsUseLightTheme toggle.

proposed_comments.title: Listen for app-theme changes
proposed_comments.body:
### Listen for app-theme changes

**Severity:** `medium`

The tray menu dark-mode decision follows the app theme, but the runner only registers a system-theme handler (`AddSystemThemeChangedHandler`). Register the refresh handler for app-theme changes as well (`AddAppThemeChangedHandler`) so menu mode updates when `AppsUseLightTheme` changes without a `SystemUsesLightTheme` change.

confidence.rationale: The tray menu theme logic checks the application theme preference, but start_tray_icon only registers a system-theme change handler. Registering AddAppThemeChangedHandler ensures menus update when the app theme changes independently.

proposed_comments.title: Respect high-contrast menu colors
proposed_comments.body:
### Respect high-contrast menu colors

**Severity:** `medium`

The fixed dark brush overrides Windows high-contrast menu colors. Check `SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST` via `SystemParametersInfoW` and skip custom menu background brushes when `HCF_HIGHCONTRASTON` is set so accessibility colors are preserved.

confidence.rationale: Applying dark_menu_brush unconditionally in dark mode overrides Windows high-contrast theme menu colors. Checking SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST for HCF_HIGHCONTRASTON preserves accessibility themes.

proposed_comments.title: Initialize dark-mode ordinals before creating the tray window
proposed_comments.body:
### Initialize dark-mode ordinals before creating the tray window

**Severity:** `medium`

`SetPreferredAppMode` should be initialized before the tray window is created, matching the referenced ZoomIt sequence. Move `DarkMode::Initialize()` before `RegisterClass(&wc)` and `CreateWindowW`.

confidence.rationale: Calling DarkMode::Initialize() after CreateWindowW can cause early menu or window creation paths to run with uninitialized preferred app mode. Following the ZoomIt precedent requires initialization before RegisterClass/CreateWindowW.
